description: Postgres backups on a schedule: pg_dump + rclone to any S3/R2, pruned by age — composed entirely from layers
contract:
# in a stack, after = ["<db>"] injects POSTGRES_ADDR — else set host/port:
POSTGRES_HOST=
POSTGRES_PORT=5432
POSTGRES_USER=postgres
POSTGRES_DB=
POSTGRES_PASSWORD=
BACKUP_DEST=:s3:my-bucket/pg
RCLONE_S3_PROVIDER=Cloudflare
RCLONE_S3_ENDPOINT=
RCLONE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID=
RCLONE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY=
BACKUP_INTERVAL=86400
BACKUP_KEEP_DAYS=14
